description: SYN-1 Hamming top-K boundary ties. 300 binary (256-bit) fingerprints around one probe: 5 at distance 1, 45 at distance 2 (two byte-identical pairs), 10 at distance 3, 50 at distance 4 (four byte-identical pairs), 190 random filler. K=10 cuts inside the 45-way tie at distance 2; K=80 cuts inside the 50-way tie at distance 4. Expected order per SYNAPSEKIT_SPEC B-6: distance ASC, vecHash ASC (FNV-1a 64 over the 32 little-endian wire bytes), itemID ASC. Every engine in both ports (Swift BruteForceIndex, Swift MIHIndex, Rust BruteForceIndex, Rust MIHIndex, and VectorStore.findNearest on both index tiers) must return exactly these ordered lists.
generator: xorshift64 over the shared seed; insertion order is a deterministic shuffle so a heap or partial sort that drops the secondary keys returns a different tie-group subset
